description: List apartments in a building. Contact details (email, phone) are left out unless includeContacts is true, and then only for callers who may manage that building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

includeContacts.description: Include tenant and owner email and phone. Default false. Only callers who may manage the building get contacts; others get only their own.

name: list_apartments
title: List apartments
